sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for Fast On-Device Agents - liquid.ai
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: an open-weight 24B reasoning model with 2B active parameters, built for fast, private on-device agents. Beats Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on LiveClaw.

sources.title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24B-parameter reasoning model with just 2B active parameters, built for fast, private agents on-device. It thinks before it answers, calls tools, and works through multi-step tasks inside popular agent harnesses.

sources.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-24B-A2B is Liquid AI's largest Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 24B total parameters with only 2B active parameters per token and a 131K context window. It is a reasoning model that always thinks before it answers, post-trained for tool calling and multi-step agentic tasks on-device. HFBaseGGUFMLXONNX
